api.purpose: Given a Sepolia burn tx, poll Circle Iris v2 for the attestation, then call receiveMessage on Arc with the admin wallet to mint USDC to the merchant. Pipeline is anchored inside ReadableStream.start() so Vercel keeps the lambda alive.
POST: brief -> LLM rubric generation -> DRAFT bounty. GET: bounty list + agent_stats in one payload. GET?id: full detail (bounty + rubric + submission + verdict + escalation).
Poster approves -> rubric FREEZES -> bounty OPEN. When DRY_RUN=false the server wallet locks USDC on-chain (lib/escrow-poster.ts). In dry-run the bounty opens with no lock.
Worker submits text or link; content is SNAPSHOT-frozen at submit time. Editing the source afterwards changes nothing.
Grade a SUBMITTED bounty against the frozen rubric with evidence citations; persist the verdict row; on T1 optionally release on-chain in the same request.

Poster acts on a T2/T3 verdict. APPROVE releases escrow (live) and marks RELEASED; REJECT is recorded and the bounty stays JUDGED. Every action lands in `escalations` — that table IS the public override_rate.
Return locked USDC to the poster after the deadline so a rejected bounty never strands escrow. Idempotent — the contract refunds once, ever.
Carry out a RELEASE verdict that never settled (day-cap deferral at judge time, or a release send that died mid-flight). Idempotent — refuses when release_tx is already recorded.
Merchant profile (auto-created on first sight) + analytics stats.
Points balance + tier + last activity, from the points_balance materialized view.
x402-protected resource. Unpaid -> HTTP 402; on payment ($0.001 USDC via Circle Gateway on Arc) -> verified, settled, JSON returned. Single static resource.
Same as /quote but payTo is the [merchant] wallet from the URL, so one gateway routes nanopayments to many merchants; each merchant's USDC accrues to its own Circle Gateway balance.
Read-only. Aggregated nano_agents rows (one rolling row per paying agent) for the dashboard card.
Read-only per-call nanopayment list. Per-call records are deliberately NOT in AIG's DB (v3.1 stores only the aggregate); individual transfers are read from Circle Gateway.

runtimeDataFlows.name: v4 Arbiter — bounty lifecycle (the money path)
steps: Browser /arbiter -> POST /api/bounty (brief) -> Anthropic API generates weighted rubric -> rows in bounties + rubrics (Supabase, service-role key, server-side)
Poster approves -> POST /api/bounty/[id]/approve-rubric -> rubric frozen -> if DRY_RUN=false: USDC approve + ArbiterEscrow.createBounty on Arc testnet
Worker -> POST /api/submission -> content snapshot into submissions

POST /api/judge -> Anthropic grades against frozen rubric -> deterministic server code computes weighted total + confidence tier (the model never computes the total, never moves money) -> verdict row persisted
T1 (conf>=85 and score>=70) -> ArbiterEscrow.release(bountyId, verdictHash) signed by the admin/arbiter wallet -> verdict hash written on-chain
T2/T3 -> escalation row -> poster APPROVE (release) or REJECT via /api/escalation -> after deadline, /api/refund returns escrow to poster

Spend brakes: PER_BOUNTY_CAP_USDC enforced in the contract AND the server; PER_DAY_CAP_USDC is a rolling-24h ledger over verdicts.release_tx (lib/arbiter/spend-ledger.ts) that FAILS CLOSED — unreadable ledger means zero headroom, no autonomous release

runtimeDataFlows.name: v2 — CCTP payment rail (Ethereum Sepolia -> Arc)
steps: Customer on /pay/[id] signs USDC.approve then TokenMessengerV2.depositForBurn on Sepolia (client-side, wagmi)
POST /api/agent/execute opens an SSE stream and polls Circle Iris v2 (GET /v2/messages/{sourceDomain}?transactionHash=) for message + attestation
Server calls receiveMessage on Arc with AIG_ADMIN_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY -> USDC minted to the merchant, minus Circle's 1bps Fast Transfer fee
Session state in payment_sessions; dashboard feed subscribes to Supabase realtime

runtimeDataFlows.name: v3 — agentic nanopayments (x402 on Arc)
steps: Autonomous agent GETs /api/nanopay/quote or /api/nanopay/m/[merchant] -> HTTP 402 with x402 payment requirements
Agent pays sub-cent USDC via Circle Gateway on Arc; server verifies + settles, returns the resource
Only the AGGREGATE is stored (nano_agents, one rolling row per agent) — per-call detail stays in Circle Gateway and is read back on demand
Points awarded in batches into points_ledger

dataStores.backup: CHUA XAC MINH — no backup or point-in-time-restore setting was verified this session. Supabase free tier does NOT keep PITR. Verify in the Supabase dashboard before treating this data as durable.

dataStores.role: Escrow balances, release/refund finality, verdict hashes. Cannot be backed up and does not need to be — but it also cannot be recreated at a new address without redeploying.
Holds per-merchant nanopayment USDC balances and the per-call transfer history that AIG deliberately does not mirror into Postgres.

externalServices.failureMode: No judging at all. Money path halts; nothing is released incorrectly.
externalServices.cost: Paid per token — the arbiter dry-run CLI spends real credits.

externalServices.failureMode: Spend ledger unreadable -> fails closed -> zero autonomous release. Dashboard blank.
v2 bridge hangs at 'bridging'; burns are NOT lost — they remain mintable once attestation lands.

externalServices.knownIssue: The public endpoint drops roughly 1 request in 4, returning 'request limit reached' as HTTP 200 with no error code, so viem does not retry it. lib/rpc-retry.ts exists specifically for this.

externalServices.purpose: Code of record — but NOT of the internal tracking files, which are gitignored.

envMatrix.note: `code` = the file that actually reads it. `vercelProduction` = present in `vercel env ls production` on 13/08. A var in code but not on Vercel means production falls back to a default or breaks; a var on Vercel but not in code is dead weight.

serverSecrets.name: AIG_ADMIN_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
serverSecrets.note: This one key is poster + arbiter + relay. Compromise = full control of the money path.

safetySwitches.name: DRY_RUN
safetySwitches.note: Every on-chain write refuses unless DRY_RUN is exactly false.

configuration.name: CIRCLE_IRIS_API_V2
configuration.note: Falls back to the hardcoded sandbox default in lib/cctp.ts.

publicClientSide.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_ETHEREUM_SEPOLIA_RPC_URL
publicClientSide.DRIFT: Vercel has ETHEREUM_SEPOLIA_RPC_URL (no NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix). A non-prefixed var is never exposed to the browser, so the client is running on whatever default providers.tsx falls back to. Either rename on Vercel or change the code.
